about: Every demo on this site that works today, for /studio/ and the navigation. Written by mistral.design@SovereignWebsite.dinis from each page's own description, 21 November 2026. A demo is listed only once its page is in site/. key: none (works with no key), mistral (your own Mistral key, held in the tab), either (your key, or a replay or local model with no key).

groups.title: Try now, no key
groups.line: Open and use: nothing to sign up for, nothing to paste.

groups.title: With your own Mistral key
groups.line: Live calls to Mistral from your browser. Your key stays in the tab's memory and goes only to Mistral; every call is shown before it is sent.

groups.title: Agentic, live on Mistral
groups.line: Agent teams, swarms and evals on Mistral models: replay the signed runs with no key, or run them on yours.

groups.title: How it works
groups.line: Where your key goes, and what runs on your own device.

demos.name: Mistral, inside your browser
demos.line: Ministral 3 3B, Mistral's Apache 2.0 model, running inside this browser tab: no key, no API. The weights download once; your messages never leave your machine.

demos.name: Your browser's key pair
demos.line: Give this browser its own key pair with Web Crypto, then send it your Mistral key sealed from another device. Kept as ciphertext; opens only when you ask.

demos.name: Seal a key for a browser
demos.line: Encrypt your Mistral key with another browser's public key, so only that browser can open it. Nothing is sent and nothing is stored.

demos.name: Vibe-build a sovereign website
demos.line: Write a brief; an agent on Mistral builds a small static website with four tools until the site's own rules pass. Preview it safely, then download it as a zip.

demos.name: Ask this site
demos.line: A streamed chat on Mistral that answers only from this site's own pages, links the pages it used, and says so when the site does not say.

demos.name: Talk to a European brain
demos.line: Ask out loud. Voxtral transcribes it, a Mistral model answers from this site's own pages, and Voxtral speaks the answer back.

demos.name: From a document to your site
demos.line: Choose a PDF or a picture. Mistral OCR reads it, a model picks out the facts with the words they came from, and only quoted words make the draft About section.

demos.name: The injection lab
demos.line: The Contact-page injection case from this site's evals, live on the Mistral model you pick, with and without untrusted-data wrapping, side by side.

demos.name: Same brief, three brains
demos.line: One brief, sent through one function to Mistral, OpenRouter and a model on your own machine, side by side, with what each call sends and to whom.

demos.name: Agents at work
demos.line: Which agents built this site, which are running now, and when each one fired, drawn live from the repository, with a timeline you can scrub.

demos.name: The team inside the site
demos.line: Seven agents inside this website, each under its own behaviour policy, on Mistral models with your own key, or replayed from recorded runs with no key.

demos.name: The Swarm, replayed
demos.line: The Sovereign Website's agent swarm run on Mistral models only: signed results of real runs, replayed in the browser, every signature checked here.

demos.name: Swarm evals
demos.line: The same signed packets run several times on Mistral models: which roles pass their checks on which model, and at what cost.

demos.name: Run the swarm yourself
demos.line: Run a signed packet of the swarm in your own browser, on your own Mistral key, one call at a time, seeing what each call sends and to whom.

demos.name: Evals for a site's jobs
demos.line: Published results of small evals of Mistral models on a sovereign website's jobs: writing, extraction, tool calling, prompt injection, translation, not inventing prices.

demos.name: Run the evals yourself
demos.line: The same eval suites in your own browser, with your own Mistral or OpenRouter key, or against a local OpenAI-compatible server such as Ollama.

demos.name: Your key, and where it goes
demos.line: Where your model key is kept, where it is sent, how to forget it, and what Mistral's free mode does with what you send.

demos.name: Level 1, on your device
demos.line: Ministral 3 on a Raspberry Pi 5 16GB: an estimate, not measured yet, the exact commands to try it, and a form to compare your own measurement.

demos.name: The first three demos
demos.line: The overview of the first demos: the model is a choice the owner makes, like the host.

demos.name: PrompTugal on Mistral
demos.line: Demos that put Mistral on PrompTugal's Portuguese public data, from your browser with your own key, each with a recorded run that replays with no key.

demos.name: Ask PrompTugal
demos.line: Ask about Portugal in European Portuguese or English: a Mistral model answers only from PrompTugal's public data and pages, citing each source.

demos.name: The PrompTugal bulletin
demos.line: A daily bulletin for Portugal in European Portuguese from public data, every figure checked in code, translated into English and French, read aloud by Voxtral.

demos.name: European or Brazilian Portuguese
demos.line: The same brief to five Mistral models, asked for European and Brazilian Portuguese, every text scanned in code for the words where the two differ.

demos.name: What should I know today?
demos.line: A Mistral agent that reads across PrompTugal's feeds for London and Portugal with tool calls in your browser, answers with each source and read time, and draws every step as a flow.

demos.name: London and Lisbon, the morning briefing
demos.line: A morning briefing for London and Lisbon side by side, written by Mistral from PrompTugal's public data, with every figure, warning and the weekday checked in code.

demos.name: PrompTugal's data feeds, mapped
demos.line: Every public data feed PrompTugal publishes, for Portugal, London and Europe: what each holds, how often it is updated, its licence, and a live sample of each.

demos.name: Workflows on Mistral
demos.line: Agent workflows on Mistral, drawn live: each agent a node, each message a dot on an arc. Recorded runs replay with no key; each runs live on your key.

demos.name: Two models, one workflow, side by side
demos.line: Planner, researchers, writer, reviewer and publisher on Mistral function calling, run on two models at once: paths, tokens, time, cost and checks compared live.

demos.name: A poster for your sovereign website
demos.line: An art director on Mistral writes the commission; Mistral's image tool paints the picture while a Mistral model draws the same poster in SVG, sanitised before it is shown.

demos.name: X-Ray: this site, claim by claim
demos.line: A page of this site checked claim by claim by two Mistral models at once: each claim a line to its source, CONFIRMED, WEAK SOURCE or NO SOURCE decided in code.

demos.name: Messages and deliverables, side by side
demos.line: The agents that built this site, replayed from the commit history: who wrote to whom, and what each made and where it went, side by side.

demos.name: Five Mistral brains, one brief
demos.line: The same six-agent workflow on five Mistral models at once, Ministral 3B to Large 4: five galaxies side by side, a podium and a league table.
